reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Global Digital Compact co-facilitation
themes.definition: Speaker highlights role in co-facilitating the UN Global Digital Compact as the framework for digital and AI governance and closing divides.
themes.inclusion: Passages referencing the Global Digital Compact or UN General Assembly processes on digital/AI governance.
themes.exclusion: General cooperation calls without UN processes (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
themes.boundary_cases: Compact commitments to close digital divides also take AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: to establish the governance required for a sustainable digital future, including with respect to artificial intelligence
Sweden is co-facilitating the process in the General Assembly of developing a global digital compact

themes.label: Harness promise while mitigating risks
themes.definition: AI framed as holding immense promise while entailing risks that must be addressed and mitigated.
themes.inclusion: Passages urging support for AI innovation while addressing risks, or harnessing potential and mitigating risks.
themes.boundary_cases: Mentions of security and human rights challenges alongside opportunities count here.

examples.quote: The global community must support innovation while addressing risks.
This fast-moving development also entails challenges for international security and human rights.

themes.label: AI for climate, health and SDGs
themes.definition: AI presented as a tool to accelerate climate action, global health and the SDGs, or address pressing common challenges.
themes.inclusion: Passages linking AI to climate, health, SDGs or common global challenges.
themes.boundary_cases: Generic 'immense promise' statements count when tied to common challenges.

examples.quote: accelerate our efforts on climate change, global health and the Sustainable Development Goals
Emerging technologies such as AI hold immense promise in addressing some of our most pressing common challenges.

themes.label: Closing digital divides
themes.definition: Commitment to close digital divides among and within countries in the context of AI and digital governance.
themes.boundary_cases: When framed only as a Compact commitment, also code AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: close digital divides among and within countries

value.rationale: Swedish passages consistently frame AI through UN multilateralism, especially the Global Digital Compact Sweden co-facilitated, pairing AI's promise for climate, health and SDGs with the need to mitigate risks and close digital divides.
